name: Fear of Boof | 1g Pre-roll | Banana
description: Church OG is a Southern California classic well known for nearly two decades. We have obsessively focused on bringing out the very best expression of this strain. A cross of God’s Gift and OG Kush, offers a nostalgic flavor profile for true OG enthusiasts. Expect lemon-pine notes layered with sweet, earthy undertones, capturing the essence of 2000-era OG strains. With its potent, full-body effects, Church OG stands out as one of the heaviest hitters in the FOB collection—a timeless classic for those seeking a deep and memorable high.
